gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma and Glioblastoma
Patients with glioblastoma or clear cell renal cell carcinoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This clinical trial aims to evaluate the diagnostic value of 68Ga-XT771, a CAIX/CAXII protein-specific probe, in PET/CT imaging for patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma and glioblastoma.
68Ga-XT771: 68Ga-XT771 is injected intravenously with a dose of 4-8 mCi

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Pathologically confirmed glioblastoma subjects will receive intravenous administration of the CAIX/CAXII-targeted probe 68Ga-XT771, followed by PET imaging.

role_evidence.quote: This clinical trial aims to evaluate the diagnostic value of 68Ga-XT771, a CAIX/CAXII protein-specific probe, in PET/CT imaging

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled CAIX/CAXII-targeted PET imaging probe (diagnostic radiotracer)

role_evidence.quote: Additionally, 11C-METHIONINE (11C-MET) PET scanning will be performed within a 4-week window

agents.drug_class_hint: carbon-11 methionine amino-acid PET tracer (comparator imaging in glioblastoma subjects)

role_evidence.quote: The subjects will also receive a 18F-FDG PET/CT or 68Ga-DPI-4552 scan within a four-week period.

agents.drug_class_hint: fluorine-18 FDG PET tracer (comparator imaging in renal cell carcinoma subjects)

role_evidence.quote: The subjects will also receive a 18F-FDG PET/CT or 68Ga-DPI-4552 scan within a four-week period.

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled PET tracer (comparator imaging in renal cell carcinoma subjects)

coder_notes: Diagnostic-only Early Phase 1 PET study in ccRCC and glioblastoma; the only registered intervention (68Ga-XT771) is a diagnostic tracer, so no candidate. 11C-methionine, 18F-FDG and 68Ga-DPI-4552 are not registered interventions but the arm text says subjects receive these comparator scans; listed as diagnostic agents for transparency (could be dropped under R9). CAIX/CAXII is the imaging target only, not recorded as a molecular biomarker. Treatment setting not stated.
